title.en: Snow Clearing: Landscape after Li Cheng

medium.en: Hanging scroll; ink and colour on paper

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: Ex coll.: C. C. Wang Family, Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Earl Morse, in honor of Professor Wen Fong, 1978

image.edit: Trimmed the dark photographic background around the object, then resized.

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1717. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1717 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A tall winter landscape in ink. Snow-covered peaks and cliffs climb toward the top, bare trees cluster on the rocks, and a stream runs through the lower half; a few lines of small characters stand in the sky at upper left.
alt.zh: 一幅竖长的水墨冬景。积雪的峰峦和山崖向上攀升，岩石上簇生着落尽叶子的树，一条溪流穿过下半部；左上方的天空里有几行小字题款。

note.en: Wang Hui, one of the Four Wangs of the early Qing, painted this in the manner of Li Cheng, a tenth-century master of wintry forests whose genuine works were already rare centuries before. Painting after an old master was a way of keeping a style alive by practising it. The white of the snow is paper left untouched, with ink laid around it.
note.zh: 王翚是清初“四王”之一，这幅仿的是十世纪擅画寒林的李成——李成的真迹早在几百年前就已罕见。“仿”某位古人，是靠亲手练习让一种画法活下去。雪的白是留出来的纸，墨围着它铺开。
